title: Pip Waits Out the Storm in the Compost Heap
checkpoint: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new graphemes eigh, ei, ey.
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new graphemes eigh, ei, ey.

pages.text: Dark clouds sit on top of the garden.
pages.illustration: Heavy dark clouds gathering over a garden, the light turning grey.

pages.text: Pip spots a gap in the compost heap.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow noticing a small, dark gap in the side of a rounded compost heap.

pages.text: Pip hops into the gap bit by bit.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow squeezing carefully into the warm gap in the compost heap.

pages.text: Rain taps hard on the garden.
pages.illustration: Heavy rain falling steadily across the garden outside the compost heap.

pages.text: Inside the heap, Pip feels snug and warm.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow tucked cosily inside the gap, warm among the layers of leaves and twigs.

pages.text: Wind huffs and puffs round the heap.
pages.illustration: Strong wind blowing leaves around the outside of the compost heap.

pages.text: Pip stays still and waits it out.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow sitting calm and still, listening to the storm outside his snug spot.

pages.text: Bit by bit, the rain stops.
pages.illustration: The rain easing off, drops slowing to a trickle outside the compost heap.

pages.text: Pip pops his head out at last.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow peeking his head out of the gap, checking the garden.

pages.text: Pip hops out, dry and warm.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow stepping out of the compost heap into a calm, sunlit garden.
